name: 5748-solodecode-dsv2lite-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 and not swept, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 120 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn: exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 512 output tokens, neither with any spread, and `ignore_eos: true` plus `temperature: 0` sent per request.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant generating medium-length replies from half-page prompts on one four-GPU node.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes this file line by
# line and skips indented ones, so a nested block silently drops the key.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration/modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 4

# The checkpoint's native window before YaRN; the longest request here is 512 + 512 = 1024.
# LOAD-BEARING: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions and the request table is allocated
# on the device as (max requests) x (context length + 4) int32 -- at that window it will not
# allocate and the server never starts.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
